items.source: The <nestedPath> tag supports and assists with nested beans or bean properties in the model. Exports a "nestedPath" variable of type String in request scope, visible to the current page and also included pages, if any.
items.translation: `<nestedPath>` 标签支持并协助处理模型中的嵌套 Bean 或 Bean 属性。在请求范围内导出一个类型为 String 的"nestedPath"变量，该变量对当前页面以及任何包含页面可见。

items.source:
The BindTag will auto-detect the current nested path and automatically
prepend it to its own path to form a complete path to the bean or bean property.
items.translation: BindTag 将自动检测当前的嵌套路径，并将其自动附加到其自身路径之前，以形成指向 Bean 或 Bean 属性的完整路径。

items.source:
This tag will also prepend any existing nested path that is currently set.
Thus, you can nest multiple nested-path tags.
items.translation: 此标签还将追加任何当前已设置的现有嵌套路径。因此，您可以嵌套多个嵌套路径标签。

items.source:
For example, "customer" to allow bind paths like "address.street"
rather than "customer.address.street".
items.translation: 例如，使用"customer"以允许绑定路径如"address.street"，而不是"customer.address.street"。

items.source: Name of the exposed variable within the scope of this tag: "nestedPath".
items.translation: 此标签作用域内暴露的变量名称："nestedPath"。
重置任何之前的嵌套路径值。

items.source: Return the path that this tag applies to.
items.translation: 返回该标签适用的路径。

items.source: Set the path that this tag should apply.
items.translation: 设置此标签应应用的路径。
